data.long_meaning: The name Rudraani is derived from the name of the Hindu god Rudra, who represents destruction and transformation. The name Rudraani can be interpreted as 'Goddess of Rudra'. In Hindu mythology, Rudra is also known as Shiva, the god of the universe, and the destroyer of evil. Rudraani is believed to embody the power and strength of Rudra, and is often invoked for protection and renewal.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rudraani is a powerful and divine name, representing the strength and protection of the Hindu god Rudra. It is a name that evokes the power of transformation and destruction, and is often invoked for spiritual growth and renewal.
data.etymology: Rudraani belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Rudra.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rudraani total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hindi.long_meaning: Rudra ke liye apna aadmi, hai woh Rudraani. Rudra ek prakritik shakti ke saath ek purush hai, jiske praan jivan hai. Is prakritik shakti ka ek avatar hai, jo rudra ke liye anusaar hai. Rudraani, wo hai jo Rudra ke liye banati hai, woh Rudra ke ghar mein rehti hai.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Rudraani is a feminine form of Rudra, the destructive aspect of Shiva. It symbolizes the fierce, transformative power of change within, enabling one to face and overcome obstacles with courage and resilience.

historical_references.reference: Rudraani is a form of the goddess Parvati, who is the consort of Lord Shiva. In Hindu mythology, Parvati is often depicted as a fierce goddess, known as Rudrani, when she is in her destructive aspect.

Rudraani is also referred to as the goddess of epidemics and diseases in the Hindu religious texts. In the Mahabharata, the great Indian epic, the god Bhagavan Rudra (Lord Shiva) is described as the protector of Rudraani, the goddess of diseases and epidemics, implying that she is under his control and protection.
